name: Open Job Cards
query:
SELECT
    name,
    customer_name,
    device_type,
    status,
    assigned_technician,
    estimated_cost,
    creation
FROM `tabJob Card`
WHERE status NOT IN ('Delivered', 'Cancelled')
ORDER BY creation DESC
